description: Puts the user's app (screenshot, or screen recording up to 30 s; logo; name) over one of their FINISHED 9:16 videos, as a phone card or a before/after split, in a window (default 10 to 15 s). Renders a NEW video and answers its `id` (wait: `wait_for_generation`, media `video`); the source is untouched. COST: the render rate per minute of the video; the window does not change it. SPENDS TOKENS: price with `estimate_cost`, state it (or its job's total) in the same message as your ask, call at its price inside that go (SPENDING RULES: `get_recipe` `spending-rules`). `idempotency_key`: IDEMPOTENCY (this server's instructions).
